data.goal:
You are performing your periodic heartbeat check for NovaTech Solutions.

## Priority Actions
1. Check your loopColony notifications (workspace_read action="notifications")
2. Process any inbound_submission or inbound_assigned notifications -- these are new leads!
3. Check for deal_stage_changed notifications -- follow up on deal progress
4. Check your open deals (crm_search entity="deal" filters={"stage": "lead"}) and follow up on stale ones
5. Mark all processed notifications as read

## If you find new leads
- Create the company in CRM (crm_write entity="company")
- Create the contact (crm_write entity="contact")
- Create a deal (crm_write entity="deal")
- Log a follow-up activity (crm_write entity="activity")

## If nothing notable
Respond with HEARTBEAT_OK

steps.description: Retrieve all workspace notifications for NovaTech Solutions using workspace_read with action='notifications'. This discovers the current state of inbound leads and deal updates without modifying anything.

Filter and categorize notifications from step 1 into: (a) new leads (inbound_submission or inbound_assigned), (b) deal stage changes (deal_stage_changed). Extract notification IDs for later marking as read. Use local logic (no tool needed) to organize this data.

For EACH new lead from step 2: (a) Create company record using crm_write(entity='company', data={name, industry, etc. from lead}), capture returned company_id; (b) Create contact using crm_write(entity='contact', data={name, email, phone, company_id}), capture contact_id; (c) Create deal using crm_write(entity='deal', data={title, stage='lead', contact_id, company_id}), capture deal_id; (d) Log initial follow-up activity using crm_write(entity='activity', data={type='call', deal_id, contact_id, due_date=today+1}). Verify each write with a crm_search query before proceeding to next record.

Search for all open deals in 'lead' stage using crm_search(entity='deal', filters={'stage': 'lead', 'company': 'NovaTech Solutions'}). Calculate age of each deal (current_date - created_date). Identify stale deals (e.g., >7 days without update).

For EACH stale deal from step 4: Create a follow-up activity using crm_write(entity='activity', data={type='email_reminder', deal_id, description='Checking in on lead progress', due_date=today}). Verify each activity creation with crm_search before proceeding to next deal.

For EACH notification ID from step 2 (both new leads and deal updates) AND step 1 (all notifications if no filtering needed): Mark as read using workspace_write(action='mark_read', notification_id=[list of IDs]). Perform this as a batch operation if API supports it, otherwise iterate per notification.

Compile final heartbeat status report: (a) Count of new leads created, (b) count of deal stage changes processed, (c) count of stale deals followed up, (d) count of notifications marked read. If all counts are zero and no errors, respond with 'HEARTBEAT_OK'. Otherwise, respond with summary of actions taken and any errors encountered.
